name: East Micronesia Cable System - Kosrae cable landing station
developer: East Micronesia Cable System consortium; DXN Limited supplier
notes: Telecom edge/cable landing infrastructure rather than a hyperscale or colocation data center. Official project site says the EMCS includes a Kosrae branch and cable landing stations to house optical transmission and power feed equipment; trade press reported Kosrae landing in September 2025 with RFS expected in November 2025.

name: Digital Federated States of Micronesia - Secure Government Network and Data Center / FSM-Cloud
developer: Government of the Federated States of Micronesia; World Bank/IDA funded
notes: National digital-government infrastructure expected to be centered around the national government in Palikir/Pohnpei. World Bank project documents list a Secure Government Network and Data Center, Disaster Recovery/Business Continuity and Government Cloud subcomponent; 2026 ISR says digital service foundations are being put in place, but does not give data-center capacity.

name: East Micronesia Cable System - Pohnpei cable landing station
developer: East Micronesia Cable System consortium; DXN Limited supplier
notes: Cable landing station, not a commercial data center. DCD reported the Pohnpei CLS delivered in March 2025; official EMCS materials describe land-based CLS facilities housing optical transmission and power feed equipment and connecting to HANTRU-1.

name: Chuuk State Solar Server Education Hub
developer: iSolutions; APNIC Foundation ISIF Asia grant
notes: Small solar-powered school connectivity/server hub, not a commercial data center. APNIC Foundation marks the 2014-2015 infrastructure grant complete and describes solar-powered computer labs, Internet connectivity, and related computing technology for remote schools in Chuuk.

name: Boom! Inc. Colonia data center / central office
notes: Small telecom central office/data center supporting local broadband, not hyperscale or colocation. APNIC Foundation technical report says Boom! built a data center/central office in Colonia, secured up to 20G IP transit/backhaul, and connected the data center to Yap's cable landing station.
